title: Data Engineering
desc: From Parquet files and the Delta transaction log to streaming pipelines, jobs and CI/CD. Small modules, one idea each.

title: Apache Spark Programming
desc: DataFrames from the first read to window functions, complex types, streaming, the Spark UI and tuning. Follows the Apache Spark Programming with Databricks course.

title: Machine Learning
desc: The ML lifecycle on Databricks: MLflow tracking, feature tables, tuning, models in Unity Catalog, serving and monitoring.

title: Generative AI
desc: LLM basics, prompting, embeddings and Vector Search, RAG, agents with tools, evaluation and governance.

title: Analytics & AI/BI
desc: SQL warehouses, dashboards, Genie spaces and metric views: getting answers out of the lakehouse.

title: Governance & Security
desc: Unity Catalog privileges, row filters and column masks, Delta Sharing, lineage and system tables.

title: Course Recaps
desc: 8-10 minute recaps of the Databricks Academy instructor-led courses, one per course day.

title: Exam Prep
desc: Preparation guides for the Databricks certifications: what the exam covers, what to know per domain, and a study plan.

title: Demo Data
desc: Seeded data generators. Each one builds several related tables with primary and foreign keys in a schema you choose.
